body.label: Target
body.html: Self or a willing ally within ranged Weapon Range and within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: A visible physical projectile Action would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 2. This cannot intercept beams, areas or nonprojectile effects.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit after the attack.
Also suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that projectile until the start of your next turn.
